title: Primary policy for Uformer reconstruction diagnostics
status: Prospective from UCOV-20261013-v1. Chosen on 2026-10-13 by the user, with knowledge of the URP-20261013-v1 result. Applying it to an earlier result is retrospective and never replaces that result's recorded verdict.

basis.state: the final registered state of the arm, never a best intermediate point
basis.space: original (unnormalized) space of the tested input

quantities.sums: SSE = sum((x_hat - x)^2), T = sum(x^2), P = sum(x_hat^2), D = sum(x_hat * x), N = number of elements; float64 reductions of the recorded final eval reconstruction
quantities.cosine: D / sqrt(P * T); undefined if P <= 0 or T <= 0
quantities.zero_prediction_mse: the recorded MSE of the all-zero prediction (equal to T / N)
quantities.scalar_mean_mse: the recorded MSE of one scalar, the mean of all N input elements, broadcast to the input shape

comparisons: inclusive, in float64, against the literal thresholds above, with no epsilon or tolerance
degenerate_input: a registered input with a non-finite element, T = 0, all elements equal (scalar-mean MSE = 0), or normalized max |x_n| >= 1 (out of the Tanh output range)

historical_strict.role: reported only; cannot veto a primary PASS

EP-20261012-v1.role: reported only; cannot veto a primary PASS
